PREAMBLE  

THIS AGREEMENT ENTERED INTO THIS 25TH DAY OF AUGUST, 1987, BY AND BETWEEN THE SCHOOL BOARD OF ORANGE COUNTY, FLORIDA, HEREINAFTER CALLED "THE BOARD" AND THE ORANGE COUNTY CLASSROOM TEACHERS ASSOCIATION, INC., HEREINAFTER CALLED THE "ASSOCIATION".
